quote: We propose the News Environment Perception Framework (NEP) ... to empower fake news detectors with the effective perception of news environments.
We report accuracy (Acc.), macro F1 score (macF1) and the F1 scores of fake and real class as evaluation metrics.
We use a pretrained language model M (e.g., BERT) to obtain the post/news representation.
We manually categorized these samples to probe what information the macro/micro environment might provide.
